outputs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original Gorefen Ripper tactical battle creature pose sheet. Use supplied original art for exact identity: low muscular crocodilian/raptor quadruped with dark olive-brown scales, long curled tail, orange-red dorsal and limb spines, enormous curved foreclaws, narrow toothy snout, blue-green eye, reed/vine bindings and small bone trinkets. No human rider, wings or armor. Exactly TWELVE separate full-creature poses in strict 3 columns and 4 rows, wide horizontal cells with generous gutters. Face RIGHT in identical three-quarter tactical camera, consistent anatomical scale. Row1: alert resting crouch mouth slightly open; slow breathing crouch neck lifted and tail shifted; crawling stride near foreclaw forward and opposite hind leg advancing. Row2: weight-passing crawling phase elbows bent, body lifted slightly; opposite crawling stride far foreclaw forward; second passing phase body compressed and tail swaying opposite. Row3: attack windup head drawn back and near foreclaw raised; powerful forward bite/claw lunge to RIGHT, neck and forelimbs extended; guarded low body with head tucked and foreclaws braced. Row4: impact recoil, neck twisting aside and body compressed; collapse on side with legs giving way and jaw slack; final fully dead body lying flat on side, legs relaxed, closed eye and tail resting along ground. Genuinely redraw anatomy and limbs in each frame, never rotate/scale the same standing cutout. Entire tail, snout and claws in every cell, no crossing gutters. All frames same body scale, corpse not enlarged. Original detailed painterly raster art, flat uniform green RGB(0,255,0) backdrop including all gaps. No ground, shadow, text, grid, extra creatures, blood or effects.
